description: Version 1.0.2 baseline datasets aligned with the dedicated JSON-LD context architecture while preserving established MSP-1 vocabulary, declaration structure, and non-binding semantics.

v1_0_2_update.summary: Updates the baseline for MSP-1 v1.0.2 context/schema separation while retaining the v1.0.1 dataset shape and record counts.
primary_changes: Uses dedicated /context/ JSON-LD resources for new page and site declarations.
Treats /schema/ resources as structural validation surfaces rather than JSON-LD contexts.
Treats v1.0.1 schema-as-context declarations as legacy compatibility input and provides migration behavior.
Does not emit page.title; page.id and page.url remain the minimal page identity fields and page.name remains optional.
Continues to treat compliance as deprecated compatibility metadata and preserves non-binding semantics.

notes: Baseline remains model-agnostic and preserves the established 62-record behavior file and 35-record validation subset.
Reference outputs demonstrate expected behavior without requiring exact wording.
Datasets are not a source of live page facts or a performance benchmark.
Previously published v1.0 and v1.0.1 directories remain immutable.
